published_basis.author: Stefan Szeider
published_basis.result: SAT for CNF with maximum deficiency k is decidable in O(2^k n^3), producing either a satisfying assignment or a regular-resolution refutation for that CNF state.

uniform_terminal_rule.current_state_size: S = encoded size of the current CNF state, S>=2
uniform_terminal_rule.action: run the exact Szeider maximum-deficiency SAT algorithm on the current CNF state
uniform_terminal_rule.original_input_accounting: If an inherited/proved L4 envelope gives S<=N^c for original input size N, then this terminal costs O(N^(4c)). R44BC itself does not prove that envelope.
output: SAT with satisfying assignment for the current CNF state
UNSAT with regular-resolution refutation for the current CNF state

scope.strength: Works for arbitrary CNF clause width, so it can consume some wider CNF successors created by previous exact transitions.
scope.representation_boundary: Does not apply directly to non-CNF states (GF(2), circuit, DNNF, selector/quantified representations, etc.) unless a separate exact polynomial conversion to a CNF state is supplied with its own accounting/replay proof.
scope.ceiling: If delta*(F)>floor(log2 S), the rule returns NO_PROGRESS and no SAT/UNSAT claim.
not_claimed: The full FPT algorithm is polynomial on unbounded maximum deficiency.
A local Szeider certificate automatically replays against the original CNF after arbitrary predecessor transitions.

combined_frontier_after_R44BC.cnf_terminal_region: Any current CNF state with delta*(F)<=floor(log2 S) has an exact O(S^4) local terminal decision.
combined_frontier_after_R44BC.residual_cnf_region: CNF states with delta*(F)>floor(log2 S) and no earlier exact rule applicable.
combined_frontier_after_R44BC.non_cnf_region: Outside R44BC scope unless independently converted exactly back to CNF with polynomial accounting and replay.

next_admissible_math.question: On high-delta* CNF critical cores, prove a uniform exact branch-compression/safe-choice transition or prove a barrier for one fixed candidate operator; separately do not assume non-CNF states inherit this terminal.
